sentences.englishText: The Old England Restaurant is located in Nailsca near Bristol and offers international cuisine to its guests.
sentences.turkishText: Eski İngiltere Restoranı, Bristol yakınlarındaki Nailsca'da yer almakta ve konuklarına uluslararası mutfak sunmaktadır.

sentences.englishText: Diners can enjoy delicious steaks and spaghetti in the lovely garden or inside the clean establishment.
sentences.turkishText: Yemek yiyenler, güzel bahçede veya temiz işletme içinde lezzetli biftek ve spagettinin tadını çıkarabilirler.

sentences.englishText: The venue also features a nightclub with music and dancing, making it perfect for special occasions.
sentences.turkishText: Mekan ayrıca müzik ve danslı bir gece kulübüne sahiptir, bu da onu özel günler için mükemmel kılar.

enrichment.summary: The Old England Restaurant is located in Nailsca near Bristol and offers international cuisine to its guests. Diners can enjoy delicious steaks and spaghetti in the lovely garden or inside the clean establishment.
